messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PDI-7892 for service=infra-serving region=eu-west az=az3 impact=degraded. Auto-notifying oncall.

pagerduty: PDI-7892 -> severity=high. Auto-escalation: after 15m to SRE lead.

Lina: acked. I'm taking primary. grabbing health metrics and request traces now.

Alice: seeing a jump in 5xx from az3 starting ~11:00 UTC. Grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.team/d/serving/eu-west?orgId=1 view=az3 (spike ~11:02).

Ben: autoscaler didn't launch new nodes in az3. quota checks show no hard AWS quota hit, but node provisioning timed out (API 504 at 11:03). collecting cloud logs.

Lina: surface impact: about 2-3% of requests in eu-west failing with transient errors, p50 latency for az3 up 3x. Other AZs normal. Support?

Carol: support POV: early customers report timeouts for streaming responses; infrequent but affects interactive features. patching status page.

Lina: runbook: check pod health, kvcache, OOMs. commands: 
```
kubectl -n serving get pods -l zone=eu-west-az3 -o wide
kubectl -n serving logs -l zone=eu-west-az3 --tail=500 | egrep -i "oom|evict|kvcache|memlock"
```

Alice: logs: repeated "kvcache eviction" and several OOMKilled events on pods in az3. sample: 
```
[11:01:23] WARN kvcache: eviction threshold reached, evicting prefix model=gpt-medium session=abcd
[11:01:32] ERROR runtime: OOMKilled pid=2345 rss=27.9G
```

Ben: infra: can scale dedicated pool for az3 from 6->10 nodes as temp capacity. request if approved. Also will attempt to restart failed instances after increasing memlock.

Lina: approve scale. Also enable region routing fallback for eu-west so new traffic goes to az2 while we stabilize. Steps: mark az3 degraded, enable fallback, scale pool.

Ben: running infra commands now:
```
infractl pools scale serving-eu-west-az3 --replicas 10  # api call in flight
routingctl set-policy eu-west fallback target=az2 enable=true
service-discovery annotate serving-eu-west-az3 status=degraded reason=kvcache-evictions
```

pagerduty: PDI-7892 acknowledged by Lina. Escalation scheduled to Ryan in 15m if unresolved.

Ryan: standing by for escalation. I'll check node kernel logs and kubelet events for mem pressure. please capture profile/heap for one affected pod.

Alice: attaching pod log snippet and top output from one node: 
```
[11:05] WARN kvcache: eviction burst, evicted 1200 prefixes
[11:06] ERROR runtime: OOMKilled process pid=2710 mem=29.1G
PID   USER   PR  NI    VIRT    RES    SHR S  %CPU %MEM   TIME+  COMMAND
2710  root   20   0  12.3G  28.4G  1.2G R   45.0  65.2  0:10.21 runtime
```

Lina: mitigation timeline (live):
- t+0: fallback enabled (new requests routed to az2)
- t+2m: infra pool scale triggered for az3 (6 -> 10)
- t+6m: restarted degraded pods with bumped memory limits and memlock adjustments

Ben: scale completed: new nodes joined and kubelet reported Ready at 11:06 UTC (4 nodes added).

Alice: starting rolling restarts for deployments in az3 with adjusted mem limits from 28Gi -> 36Gi:
```
kubectl -n serving set resources deploy/serving-az3 --limits=memory=36Gi --record
kubectl -n serving rollout restart deploy/serving-az3 --timeout=10m
```

Carol: customer message draft: "We are investigating degraded inference performance in eu-west; traffic is temporarily routed to an alternate availability zone and we have added capacity. We will provide an update within 15 minutes." :mega:

Lina: can someone tail request logs to validate fallback is handling new traffic? tail command: `tail -f /var/log/requests.log | sed -u -n '1,$p' | grep eu-west`

Alice: validation: new requests predominantly land in az2; error rate for new traffic -> ~0.1%. overall eu-west error rate trending down from 6% -> 0.7%. p50 latency mostly recovered.

pagerduty: auto-escalation timer extended by Lina. next escalation checkpoint in 15m.

Ryan: kernel logs show oom_killer traces and processes being SIGKILLed. memlock limit was low on runtime container; bumping RLIMIT_MEMLOCK and applying a temporary sysctl for vm.overcommit_memory=1 on new nodes. Also filing INFRA-2245 to track permanent fix.

Ben: applied sysctl and restarted kubelet on new nodes. adjusted pod spec to raise memlock and memory requests. continuing restarts.

Lina: monitoring: error rate across eu-west now 0.25%. residual retries, but no customer escalations so far. marking incident as partially mitigated.

Carol: posting status update on status.redwood.ai: "Mitigation in progress — traffic diverted and additional capacity added to eu-west. Continued monitoring."

Alice: finishing restarts; old pods terminating gracefully. memory limit bump confirmed in running pods.

Lina: plan: keep routing fallback enabled until az3 sustains error <0.1% for 10 continuous mins. also run post-incident heap/kvcache profile capture and produce a short RCA.

Ryan: follow-ups: root cause hypothesis = combination of sudden kvcache eviction storm + insufficient memlock settings causing runtime to OOM under sustained prefix pressure. action items: (1) permanent memlock config rollout, (2) autoscaler diagnostics for provisioning timeouts, (3) kvcache eviction backpressure improvements.

pagerduty: PDI-7892 status -> acknowledged -> partial_mitigated. auto-escalation cleared.

Lina: handing back to normal oncall. will open INC-2026-045 and attach Grafana / logs. close PD when incident ticket created.

Carol: preparing 90-min customer summary to include mitigation timeline and impact estimate. will attach INC link when available.

Alice: final metrics check: p50 eu-west = baseline, error rate = 0.12% (down from 6%). continuing 30m monitoring window.

Lina: :white_check_mark: incident updates paused. reopen PD if error spikes >1% or new OOMs appear.

incident-bot: PDI-7892 updated -> state=monitoring; thread will be archived when incident closed.
